# oneagent

> oneagent is a one-shot AI agent CLI. It is a single Rust binary that takes a
> task on the command line, calls an OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions model,
> does the work with the shell tools already on the machine, prints one answer
> and exits. The installed command is `ma`. macOS and Linux.

## Key facts

- Language: Rust (edition 2024, rust 1.85+)
- Binary: `ma`, one native executable, no language runtime required at run time
- Platforms: macOS (Apple Silicon, Big Sur 11.0+) and Linux (x86_64, glibc 2.34+)
- Model backend: any OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions endpoint with tool calling
- License: MIT
- Differentiation: one-shot, not a resident session. No daemon, no state between
  runs. Composes with stdin/stdout, so it drops into a shell pipeline, Makefile
  or CI step. Contrast with resident coding agents (Claude Code, aider), which
  hold an interactive session and ship their own tool suite.

## Notes

- Named `oneagent` on crates.io and GitHub; the command is `ma`. The project was
  renamed from `mini-agent`, and the old repository URL redirects.
- `llms.txt` first published 2026-10-09.
